blocks.title: Libraries aur modules
blocks.text: Libraries aur modules tayyar auzaaron ke dabbon jaise hain jo sab kuch shuru se banaye baghair masail hal karte hain.
Yeh hissa dikhata hai ke standard aur third-party libraries kaise import aur istemal hoti hain, Python modules kaise dhoondti hai aur modules packages mein kaise munazzam hote hain.

blocks.prompt: Sab kuch khud likhne ki bajaye library kyun istemal karein?
blocks.explanation: Yeh waqt aur mehnat bachati aur aazmooda tools deti hai, to aap apne masle par tawajjo de sakte hain.

items: Libraries aur modules: tayyar code ke dabbe; pahiya dobara ijad karne ki bajaye import karein.
